deal_value.notes: Recommended cash offer of 110p per share; equity value ~GBP 99M (~USD 120M at ~1.21 USD/GBP, Oct 2023 approx.); enterprise value ~GBP 87M (~USD 105M) net of cash. Scheme of arrangement; completed and delisted Dec 12, 2023 with 97% shareholder support.

ev_multiple.basis: EV (~GBP 87M) / trailing-twelve-month adjusted EBITDA (~GBP 8M, TTM to July 31, 2023), stated in CoStar's offer press release

revenue_multiple.basis: EV (~GBP 87M) / trailing-twelve-month revenue (~GBP 35M, TTM to July 31, 2023), stated in CoStar's offer press release

calculable.calculation: GBP 87M EV / GBP 35M TTM revenue = 2.5x; GBP 87M / GBP 8M TTM adjusted EBITDA = 10.9x
inputs: OnTheMarket TTM (to July 31, 2023) revenue ~GBP 35M, adjusted EBITDA ~GBP 8M — same CoStar announcement; OnTheMarket was AIM-listed with audited public accounts

sources.title: CoStar Group — Offer to acquire OnTheMarket (press release with 2.5x revenue / 11x adj. EBITDA multiples)

notes: CoStar's own announcement published the transaction multiples (2.5x TTM revenue, 11x TTM adjusted EBITDA on ~GBP 87M EV), so verdict is 'published'. GBP-USD conversion is approximate (~1.21 at announcement). CoStar press-room page returned 403 to direct fetch; multiples were quoted in search-indexed copies of the same release (Business Wire/press room).
